newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOCCER-BULGARIA WARY OF DROPPING POINTS AGAINST ISRAEL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BULGARIA WARY OF DROPPING POINTS AGAINST ISRAEL.

text.p: Bulgaria host Israel in a World Cup qualifier on Wednesday that could go a long way towards deciding the destiny of group five.

Russia top the group with 14 points from six games with Wednesday's protagonists second and third. Israel, bidding to qualify for the finals for only the second time, have 13 points from seven games with Bulgaria a point back but with two games in hand.
Bulgaria, semifinalists in the 1994 World Cup, lost 2-1 to Israel in their first meeting and cannot afford a another slip with two games against Russia still to come.
"Our goal in the match is victory," said Bulgaria coach Hristo Bonev. "We know the strengths and weaknesses of the Israeli team. They are a strong side and have surprised a few people."

Bulgarian striker Hristo Stoichkov also gave credit to the Israelis but said his team mates were in confident mood. "These 90 minutes will be much harder than the match against Russia," said the Barcelona man. "But not one of us thinks we will lose this match."

The squad have gathered in the village of Pancharevo on the outskirts of Sofia for their first training session. They will be joined by Ivailo Yordanov from Portugal's Sporting Lisbon who is expected to arrive later on Friday.
This will be Israel's final qualifying match while Bulgaria host Russia on September 10 and then play the return fixture on October 11.
